title: MFO — R package for Maximal Fat Oxidation and kinetics
text: R package MFO (CRAN: v0.1.0, 2022; GitHub: v0.2.0, Feb 2026). Computes maximal fat oxidation (MFO), Fatmax, Fatmax zone, crossover point SIN kinetics model (Chenevière 2009) indirect-calorimetry data. Target users: sport health scientists. Roadmap: v0.2.x CRAN -> v0.3.0 (reliability, uncertainty, protocols, importers, Shiny app) -> JOSS paper. scientific specification lives docs/SPEC.md (exported project doc “MFO: fundamentos científicos y técnicos”). Sections 9.5 12–17 backlog. Read SPEC.md touching formula. Never change coefficient without citing source roxygen block adding unit test paper’s numbers.

text: ci: GitHub Actions R-CMD-check (ubuntu/macos/windows) + test-coverage + pkgdown. Remove dead Travis badge; add check/coverage/CRAN badges. docs: rewrite README v0.2.x (methods P3/P2/MRER, equations, RER cutoff, relative outputs); fill NEWS.md (0.1.0, 0.2.0, 0.2.1). fix: VO2max db_graded = highest rolling mean vo2max_window s (default 30), instantaneous max. SPEC 9.5 / 14. fix: basal substrate oxidation uses author equation test. SPEC 9.5. feat: include_basal = TRUE argument (basal point step 0 fit). SPEC 9.5. fix: Jeukendrup–Wallis equations warn outside 40–75 %VO2max. SPEC 3 / 9.5. fix: SIN model formula: code (pi^(1/s) / pi + 2*d); Chenevière 2009 eq. [14] pi^(1/s) / (pi + 2*d). Add regression test d = 0.18, s = 1.52, t = 0.21 (Fig. 5): fitted curve must reproduce Fatmax = [(pi+2d)*2^(-1/s) - d - t]/K Fatmin = (pi+d-t)/K. SPEC 6.5 / 19 (finding 5). 7b. fix: SIN fitting procedure: drop P3 smoothing synthetic grid; fit nlsLM directly observed step values (%MFO, normalised observed max). Fatmin = second zero curve (default), fatmin_threshold optional. SPEC 19 (findings 3, 7). 7c. feat: method MV (measured values, author equation) real MRER (linear fits (1-RER) VO2 vs intensity, vertex product). Current MRER behaviour becomes MV; keep MRER string working deprecation message one release. SPEC 6.1 / 19 (finding 4). 7d. fix: Péronnet–Massicotte coefficients derived code Table 1 constants (O2 0.7455 / CO2 0.7426 L per g glucose; 2.0092 / 1.4136 L per g fatty acid) solving 2x2 system; Frayn Table 1. Unit test: derived values equal 4.58519/3.22597 1.69469/1.70130. SPEC 19 (finding 6). 7e. feat: energy_equivalents argument per-equation defaults (Péronnet 3.8683/9.7460 kcal/g; Jeukendrup 4.15/9.75; Frayn: product decision pending, see SPEC 19 finding 1). RER_cutoff accepts named values “classic” 1.00, “safe” 0.95, “sedentary” 0.93, “trained” 0.90 (Amaro-Gahete 2019). SPEC 19 (findings 1, 2). feat: warn incomplete last step missing HR; min_steps (default 6) warning; warning Fatmax lands first last step. SPEC 9.5 / 14. docs: vignette “gas exchange Fatmax” reproducing README example explaining every parameter. pkgdown site reference grouped workflow. chore: cran-comments.md, inst/CITATION, submit v0.2.1 CRAN. Phase 2 (v0.3.0) starts CRAN acceptance: SPEC sections 12–17, one issue .

title: Maximal Fat Oxidation and Kinetics Calculation
text: step contributes one point (FAT, %VO2max). method chooses maximum located: "P3" (default): third-degree polynomial FAT(x)=+bx+cx2+dx3\mathrm{FAT}(x) = + bx + cx^2 + dx^3, xx = %VO2max. Fatmax root b+2cx+3dx2=0b + 2cx + 3dx^2 = 0 lies within measured range gives highest FAT. Falls back P2 warning cubic fitted. "P2": parabola, Fatmax =−b/2c= -b / 2c. stable steps, forces symmetric curve. "MRER": step highest observed FAT=1.7(1−RER)VO2\mathrm{FAT} = 1.7\,(1 - \mathrm{RER})\,\mathrm{VO_2} (see Known issues). P3 P2 fit’s R_squared RMSE returned. Fatmax zone range intensities fitted FAT ≥ 90 % MFO (Achten et al., 2002). crossover point intensity CHO exceeds FAT, linear interpolation steps.

title: Maximal Fat Oxidation and Kinetics Calculation
text: MFO_kinetics() normalises fat oxidation %MFO fits three-parameter sine model Chenevière et al. (2009, eq. 14) non-linear least squares (minpack.lm::nlsLM): %MFO(x)=sin⁡{[π1/sπ+2d(Kx+d+t)]s},K=π100 \%\mathrm{MFO}(x) = \sin\left\{\left[\frac{\pi^{1/s}}{\pi + 2d}\left(Kx + d + t\right)\right]^{s}\right\}, \qquad K = \frac{\pi}{100} d (dilatation): d > 0 widens curve, d < 0 narrows . s (symmetry): s > 1 shifts peak right steeper fall; s < 1 opposite. t (translation): t > 0 shifts whole curve left. d = 0, s = 1 t = 0 curve half sine wave peaking 50 %VO2max.

title: Maximal Fat Oxidation & FatMax Function — MFO
text: step_time often data collected (seconds). db_MFO database containing MFO test. db_basal database containing basal test. db_graded database containing incremental exercise test (optional VO2max provided). cv_var variable estimate coefficient variation. Can : "VO2", "VCO2" "RER". author author estimate MFO. Can : "Frayn", "Jeukendrup" "Peronnet". VO2max VO2max can passed directly (ml/min) instead using db_graded. method curve-fitting method: "P3" (3rd-degree polynomial, default), "P2" (2nd-degree polynomial), "MRER" (RER-based method Perez-Martin et al.). step_duration duration exercise step seconds (default 180 = 3 min). steady_state_duration duration steady-state period average within step, seconds (default 60). RER_cutoff RER value steps excluded (default NULL = cutoff). Recommended values: 1.0 (general), 0.93 (sedentary/obese), 0.90 (trained). negative_FAT handle negative fat oxidation values: "truncate" (set 0, default), "exclude" (remove fitting), "keep" (include fitting). body_mass body mass kg (optional, relative MFO calculation). fat_free_mass fat-free mass kg (optional, FFM-relative MFO calculation). HRmax maximum heart rate bpm (optional, FatMax %HRmax).

title: Maximal Fat Oxidation & FatMax Function — MFO
text: Returns list contains: MFO_db: database Load, VO2, VCO2, HR, RER, CHO, FAT, Kcal, porc_VO2. MFO_plot: ggplot object MFO plot including FAT CHO curves. MFO: Maximal fat oxidation (g/min). MFO_relative: MFO relative body mass (mg/kg/min), body_mass provided. MFO_FFM: MFO relative fat-free mass (mg/kgFFM/min), fat_free_mass provided. FAT_MAX: Intensity elicits MFO (% VO2max). FAT_MAX_HR: Heart rate FatMax (bpm), interpolated data. FAT_MAX_porcHRmax: FatMax % HRmax, HRmax provided. FatMax_zone_lower: Lower bound FatMax zone (% VO2max). FatMax_zone_upper: Upper bound FatMax zone (% VO2max). crossover_point: Intensity CHO > FAT (% VO2max). R_squared: R-squared fitted model. RMSE: Root mean squared error fitted model. method: Method used curve fitting. x_CHO: carbohydrates basal metabolism (g/min). x_FAT: fat basal metabolism (g/min). x_Kcal: Kcal basal metabolism (kcal/min).

title: Maximal Fat Oxidation Kinetics (SIN Model) — MFO_kinetics
text: Returns list contains: MFO_kinetics_data: database used create MFO kinetics plot (original data plus normalized %MFO). MFO_kinetics_plot: ggplot object comparing basic fitted SIN models. d: dilatation parameter (controls vertical scaling/width curve). t: translation parameter (horizontal shift along intensity axis). s: symmetry parameter (controls curve shape asymmetry; <1 left-skew, >1 right-skew). Fatmin: exercise intensity (% VO2max) fat oxidation becomes negligible. FatMax_SIN: exercise intensity (% VO2max) peak fat oxidation SIN model. R_squared: R-squared SIN model fit. RMSE: Root mean squared error SIN model fit. d_se: standard error dilatation parameter. s_se: standard error symmetry parameter. t_se: standard error translation parameter. convergence: logical, whether SIN model converged.

title: MFO (development version)
text: Found verifying code primary sources (SPEC sections 9.5 19): SIN model MFO_kinetics() computes pi^(1/s) / pi + 2*d instead pi^(1/s) / (pi + 2*d) (Cheneviere et al., 2009, eq. 14). Values d v0.1.0/v0.2.0 comparable published values. MFO_kinetics() fits SIN model P3-smoothed synthetic grid instead observed steps, defines Fatmin 5 % threshold instead second zero curve. method = "MRER" measured-values method 1.7 * (1 - RER) * VO2, two-regression MRER procedure. VO2max db_graded single highest record, rolling mean. Resting values always use Frayn’s equations, resting row dropped curve fit. Péronnet–Massicotte coefficients rounded constants rather derived Table 1; energy equivalents 4/9 kcal/g equations.

title: MFO 0.2.0
text: GitHub release (February 2026). submitted CRAN.

title: MFO 0.2.0
text: MFO() gains method choose curve-fitting method: "P3" (third-degree polynomial, new default), "P2" "MRER". Version 0.1.0 always used second-degree polynomial. MFO() gains author = "Peronnet" (Péronnet & Massicotte, 1991) addition "Frayn" "Jeukendrup". New protocol arguments MFO() MFOs(): step_duration (default 180 s) steady_state_duration (default 60 s). New artefact handling: RER_cutoff removes steps RER threshold; negative_FAT chooses whether negative fat oxidation truncated 0, excluded kept. New outputs MFO(): Fatmax zone (fat oxidation within 10 % MFO), crossover point, heart rate Fatmax Fatmax %HRmax (HRmax), MFO relative body mass (body_mass) fat-free mass (fat_free_mass), R_squared / RMSE fit. MFO_kinetics() now returns standard errors d, s t, FatMax_SIN, Fatmin, R_squared, RMSE convergence flag, handles fitting failures without stopping. MFOs() passes new MFO() arguments gains output_format ("xlsx", "csv" "rds"). Internal helper average breath--breath data fixed intervals.

title: MFO 0.2.0
text: Requires R >= 4.1.0 (R >= 2.10). Expanded unit tests.

title: MFO 0.1.0
text: CRAN release: 2022-02-11 First CRAN release (February 2022). MFO() computes MFO Fatmax resting, incremental maximal test data, Frayn (1983) Jeukendrup & Wallis (2005) equations second-degree polynomial fit. MFO_kinetics() fits SIN model Cheneviere et al. (2009) returns dilatation, symmetry translation. MFOs() processes folder participants.
